name: B1050 - Web - File Transfer Services Control
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Web clipboard paste and upload into the Unauthorized File Transfer Services surface at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down sensitive data exfil through non-sanctioned file-sharing platforms. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
